_what_this_is: One probe wall's declared geometry, written before any candidate exists. Every bracket here is the standing +/-8 % propagated through a geometry this wall declares; nothing in it is chosen, and the measurement reads its windows from this file.
why_this_wall: a flight wall: the shortened stair paragraph and the FLIGHT_ASK handshake with promote-backdrop.mjs, on a wall that also carries a window

meta_used.calibration_ref: wall grid module, 1.0 m at the wall plane

meta_origin: the meta the page holds for this facing (derived: this wall is not promoted)

vanishing_point._derivation: the intersection of this facing's own two side-wall junction lines as renderer.js drawGrid draws them, computed rather than assumed to be the frame centre

brackets._derivation: every width is MEASURED_BAND (the standing +/-8 % on the implied focal length AND the eye height) propagated through a geometry this scaffold declares; nothing here is chosen

floor_window.from: +/-8 % of the floor-to-horizon separation, which is eye x px_per_m_at_wall

rail_band.from: +/-8 % of the anchor's own height above the floor line

carrier_windows.from: the stamped box dilated by this wall's own measured reflex-versus-plan separation

_edge_provenance: COMPOSED FROM DECLARED GEOMETRY, NOT A SHIPPED-RENDERER CAPTURE. frame.png and scaffold.png come out of window.HOLO.renderer.render and carry row 23 §7.1's guarantee that the picture a painter is given is the picture a player sees; edge.png does not. Plan §1.2 makes re-establishing that guarantee a named condition on folding v5 into production.
